mods.name: Community Browser
mods.summary: A COMMUNITY button in the main menu that lists Project Playtime 2.0.3 lobbies by category.
mods.description:
Opens the old server browser and finds 2.0.3 games, including ones already running.
Join opens the host's Steam profile so you can connect from there.

mods.name: Connection Info
mods.summary: Ping to the host, FPS and host name at the top of the screen while you are not hosting.
mods.description:
Turn it on in Settings > Gameplay > CONNECTION INFO.
During a round it shows your ping to the host (GOOD / OK / BAD), your frame rate and who is hosting.

mods.name: Cosmetics Hitch Fix
mods.summary: Opening outfits and the store no longer freezes the menu for seconds.
mods.description:
The outfit list used to load every cosmetic item with all its meshes at once, and the store rebuilt tooltips for every card.
Now only what is needed is loaded, so the menus stay smooth.

mods.name: Cosmetics Testing Level
mods.summary: Brings back the developer button that opens the cosmetics testing level, and makes the level playable.
mods.description:
Adds the hidden Cosmetics Testing Level button to the main menu.
In the level you can walk around with your current outfit and look at it from every side.

mods.name: Double-Click Guard
mods.summary: Fast double clicks in the menus no longer break creating, joining or starting a lobby.
mods.description:
Clicking a menu button twice while Steam is still busy used to start two lobbies or leave one half open.
Clicks that arrive while the game is still working on the last one are ignored now.

changes: Removed the diagnostic messages that were sent to Steam Rich Presence

mods.name: Instant Piano Keys
mods.summary: Your key lights up and sounds the moment you press it. The host still decides right or wrong.
mods.description:
Playing as a client normally means waiting for the host before a piano key reacts.
With this mod your own presses light up and play their note right away.
Whether the press was correct still comes from the host, so nothing is guessed.

changes: Removed the diagnostic messages that were sent to Steam Rich Presence
Only the key press is instant, the right/wrong answer always comes from the host

mods.name: Map Vote Fix
mods.summary: The map vote roulette no longer spins forever.
mods.description: When the same map won again the roulette restarted itself endlessly. It now stops on the chosen map.

mods.name: Phantom Lobby Fix
mods.summary: After a kick or a lost connection you really leave the old lobby instead of staying stuck in it.
mods.description:
Without this fix the game could keep you in a lobby that no longer exists after you were kicked or lost the connection,
so the next match or private lobby behaved strangely. Now the old lobby is left and reset cleanly.

mods.name: Private Match
mods.summary: Lobbies only your friends can join: pick a side, create a match, then invite friends or share the four-digit code.
mods.description:
Main menu > PRIVATE MATCH > choose Monster or Specialist > CREATE MATCH.
Invite friends with the + button above the menu icons. It opens your Steam friends list.
When a friend accepts, their game opens Private Match and joins your lobby, even if it was closed.
Friends can also join with the key button (LOBBY CODE). The host starts the round with two or more players.
Everyone in the lobby needs this mod.

changes: Invite Steam friends with the + button in the lobby
Accepting an invite opens Private Match and joins the lobby, also when the game was closed

mods.name: Sound Packs
mods.summary: Sound packs you own actually play: menu music, lobby, ambience and puzzle sounds.
mods.description:
Pick a sound pack in the lobby and it is used for the main menu music, the round ambience and the puzzle sounds.
Packs can be previewed and switched off again, and the store shows which pack is active.

mods.name: Tutorials
mods.summary: Play the Specialist tutorial again: a Tutorial button in the matchmaking sidebar, with working train, revive and Huggy.
mods.description:
Adds a Tutorial button next to the character selection. Specialists get the Specialist tutorial.
Fixes what 2.0.5 broke: camera and grabpack at the start, narrator and subtitles, the train,
Huggy chasing you and carrying you to the Wuggy hole, and being revived from it.

mods.name: Unlock All Cosmetics
mods.summary: Every outfit, skin and emote is unlocked.
mods.description:
Project Playtime has ended operations and cosmetics can no longer be bought.
This mod marks every cosmetic item as unlocked, so all outfits, skins and emotes can be used.
